cohort: The cohort consisted of 19,515,843 livebirths in Brazil born between Jan 1, 2012, and Dec 31, 2018, followed up to age 5 years, death, or Dec 31, 2018.
finding: Children of Indigenous, Black, and Brown or Mixed race mothers in Brazil experienced substantially higher mortality risks before age 5 years compared to children of White mothers, with the highest disparities observed during the post-neonatal period and between ages 1-4 years, and for specific causes like malnutrition, diarrhoea, and influenza/pneumonia.
